crs.name: WISPR:MOON_ME_DE421_SOUTH_POLAR_STEREOGRAPHIC
crs.latitude_convention: planetocentric latitude in degrees (on source sphere)
crs.vertical_reference: DEM height Z in metres as defined by NASA PGDA; verify JPL Horizons compatibility before using observer elevation
crs.geojson_note: Project-specific GeoJSON with lunar metres, NOT RFC7946 WGS84

grid.preservation: Rows 0..9 and columns 0..9 are spatially identical to V1. Only boundary neighbor lists expand.
grid.source_vertical_height: metres as specified in NASA LOLA DEM

methods.elevation_m: arithmetic mean of 400 native 5m DEM heights per 100m cell
methods.elevation_min_m: minimum native DEM height in cell
methods.elevation_max_m: maximum native DEM height in cell
methods.elevation_std_m: population standard deviation of native DEM heights
methods.slope_deg: mean arctan of 5m DEM centered-difference derivatives (dzdx,dzdy), one-pixel halo
methods.slope_max_deg: maximum native-pixel derived slope, not a landing threshold
methods.roughness_m: root mean square residual of native heights after per-cell least squares plane fit
methods.missing: Abort generation on any invalid source or gradient pixel. Never invent values.
methods.quality: Interpolated LOLA DEM: high pixel spacing does not mean every pixel independently observed.

parquet.geometry_wkb: OGC WKB polygon coordinates in lunar projected metres
parquet.writer: minimal Apache-Thrift/Parquet PLAIN/UNCOMPRESSED REQUIRED fields; independent interoperability check needed

models.mesh_coordinates: [X_m, Y_m, Z_m] = original projected lunar X/Y and DEM elevation
models.mesh_vertices: one per native DEM pixel center, exact 5 m spacing
models.mesh_vertex_extent: pixel centres inset 2.5 m from outer cell boundaries
models.moon_globe_registration: not supplied; global globe may have unrelated axis/orientation until independently registered
models.rendering: Z is terrain up; adapt Three.js camera.up or camera/orientation accordingly; never rotate science data in saved files
